question: Which Base primitives provide attestations, role tokens, multisig custody with scoped permissions, and price references, at which verified address and audit status, as of 2026-10-08?

frame.exposure: contract calls for attestation, role checks, treasury execution and price reads
frame.comparator: EAS, Hats, Safe with Zodiac Roles, Chainlink

item.title: Ethereum Attestation Service predeploys on Base

findings.finding: Base predeploys: EAS 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000021 and SchemaRegistry 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000020 each have 4,113 hex chars of code (proxy-sized) and version() returns "1.0.1". getSchemaRegistry() on the EAS address returned 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000020.

notFound: Predeploy proxy admin was not read.
No audit report files in the eas-contracts shallow clone.

item.title: Safe singleton and proxy factory on Base

findings.finding: Safe singleton 0x41675C099F32341bf84BFc5382aF534df5C7461a on Base has 47,161 hex chars of code and VERSION() returns "1.4.1"; proxy factory 0x4e1DCf7AD4e460CfD30791CCC4F9c8a4f820ec67 has code. The same two addresses have code on Gnosis. The Morpho Blue owner Safe 0xcBa28b38... answers getThreshold() = 5 over 9 owners; the Steakhouse Vault V2 owner Safe 0x639bfA26... was queried and returned an owner list read error.

Audit directory https://github.com/safe-global/safe-smart-account/tree/main/docs lists Gnosis_Safe_Audit_Report for versions 1.0 to 1.3.0 (final), a formal verification report for 1.0.0 and a symbolic execution report.

notFound: Safe 1.4.1 audit reports (the docs listing named reports up to 1.3.0 in the first eight entries read).
